question: What is the closing number we are trying to beat, at which book, for each market?
what_we_have: Nothing - no odds data exists in the repo and nfl.com publishes none (F-14)
what_we_need: Opening + closing spread, total, moneyline and prop prices with book, market id, timestamp, and result/settlement for at least 5 seasons
how_to_obtain: Buy a licensed odds API (SRC-016) or run the sportsbook-scraping worker on a host with outbound access; store every read with a UTC timestamp before kickoff
decision_it_unblocks: Without it there is no CLV, no hold realism, no gate G-03, and no leaderboard - lines can be built but never scored

question: Which players are actually starting, and who is the first replacement at each position?
what_we_have: The official weekly report (28 clubs read for Week 10) gives availability status and position only
what_we_need: Per-club depth chart by position group, per game, with snap counts, plus the game-day inactives list
how_to_obtain: 32 club sites (SRC-017) versioned daily + NFL game broadcast inactives; snap counts require a licensed stats feed (NFL Stats / Sportradar)
decision_it_unblocks: Starter-vs-backup adjustment strength (currently 0.0 in models/line_model.yaml) and signals S-01, S-03, S-04, S-05, S-06

question: Does an IR designation remove a player from the report entirely, and for how long?
what_we_have: Yes in practice - BAL's report has 8 rows and no Lamar Jackson while SRC-009 headlines say Jackson is out 6-10 weeks
what_we_need: A machine-readable IR / NFI / PUP / non-runner feed with placement and activation dates, per club, per day
how_to_obtain: Transaction wires (nfl.com/transactions), club PR accounts, or the NFL Transactions API (paywalled)
decision_it_unblocks: Any 'deficiency' count that only reads the weekly report under-counts by roughly one full roster unit; blocks the availability module

question: Complete game-level results for 2026 Weeks 3-18 and for at least 5 prior seasons (score, date, venue, home team, refs, weather, lines).
what_we_have: 32 of 137 games verified (Weeks 1-2); standings give every club's aggregate PF/PA through Week 9
what_we_need: Per-game rows with the same source discipline applied to Weeks 1-2
how_to_obtain: scripts/fetch_nfl_data.py on a networked host (needs nfl.com reachability; sandbox is blocked - see COORDINATION.md capability table)
decision_it_unblocks: Margin standard deviation, total variance, home-field value, push frequency - i.e. every scaling constant in the line model

question: What is the correct points-per-rating conversion and the true residual SD of a game margin around a fair line?
what_we_have: Provisional only from n=32 games
what_we_need: Residual SD of (actual margin - model margin) on a full sample, and the same for totals
how_to_obtain: After Q-04, one OLS/robust regression; re-estimate each season and freeze before play
decision_it_unblocks: Spread/total width, and therefore the size of any edge that survives the -110/prop vig

question: What is home-field advantage in points for 2026 - and is it still what the market assumes?
what_we_have: No verified value; the standings page's HOME/ROAD columns are published but not machine-readable in the static HTML
what_we_need: Home-team margin mean and SE by season, venue type (open/retractable/dome), altitude and travel distance
how_to_obtain: Derived from Q-04 once game-level rows exist; venue roof/altitude from club stadium pages (official-club)
decision_it_unblocks: "Adjust +0 or +2.0" is a pricing decision, not a research opinion; it moves roughly 20% of spreads

question: What are the empirical correlations that a parlay price depends on (team total vs margin, both legs of a same-game parlay, prop vs game script)?
what_we_have: Formula and estimators specified in docs/correlation.md; no values published because the game-level sample is incomplete (Q-04)
what_we_need: Covariance matrix by bet-type pair, measured on settled bets, plus club-level simulation calibration
how_to_obtain: Compute in scripts/correlation.py after Q-04; refresh weekly in season
decision_it_unblocks: Parlay and prop-combo pricing; without it we are pricing parlays as if legs were independent, which is the single biggest systematic error a prop bettor makes

question: What are the per-player rates (targets, routes, snap share, carries inside the 10, red-zone touches)?
what_we_have: Team-level pass/rush volume is verified (SRC-003/004)
what_we_need: Player-level per-game rates with the same provenance discipline
how_to_obtain: Official NFL/NEXT Gen Stats + a licensed player-stats feed
decision_it_unblocks: Player prop lines can only be modelled at team level until this exists; that caps prop edge to game-script angles

question: Confirm from the official rulebook (not media coverage) the exact overtime procedure for 2026 and its effect on tie probability.
what_we_have: Secondary sources describe the 2025 change (SRC-014); the 2026 rulebook landing page lists only the 2026 amendments
what_we_need: Rule 16 text from the official 2026 PDF (SRC-010) + measured frequency of games reaching OT and of ties
how_to_obtain: Open the PDF section 16 and read it into docs/league-facts.md; count OT/ties from Q-04 data
decision_it_unblocks: Push/tie handling in spread and moneyline pricing; a tie on a -3 spread is a push, and the frequency is a real pricing input, not a rounding issue

question: Which books will actually take our action, at what limit, and how fast do they limit us?
what_we_have: Nothing
what_we_need: Account-level limit matrix by market, bet size cap, and measured time-to-limit
how_to_obtain: Operational test in paper form first; then small-stake pilot
decision_it_unblocks: Any edge estimate that ignores max staking is fantasy; this decides whether we need 30 books or 3

question: What is the exact settlement source for each prop (official stat, corrected stat, or book's own ruling)?
what_we_have: nfl.com publishes stat corrections ("Error Sheet") but the repo has no record of the policy text
what_we_need: The league's statistical-corrections policy + each book's prop-settlement rule text
how_to_obtain: Read the official NFL stats policy and archive each book's rules page
decision_it_unblocks: Prop model must be evaluated against the settlement source, not against our idea of the 'true' stat

question: Which Week 10+ venues are open-air, and do we price weather at all?
what_we_have: No weather data in the repo
what_we_need: Stadium roof type per venue + NWS forecast at kickoff (SRC-015)
how_to_obtain: One-off club stadium pages (official-club) + a forecast fetch before each slate
decision_it_unblocks: Whether to add a wind/cold total adjustment; historically the largest non-injury total driver in Nov-Dec outdoor games

question: Do the Munich / East Melbourne games carry a measurable rest or travel effect?
what_we_have: Two fixtures identified (F-02) and the rest-day consequence is visible in the schedule
what_we_need: Historical international-game margins vs the market (very small sample: 2 games in 2026 so far)
how_to_obtain: From Q-01 + Q-04
decision_it_unblocks: Whether to run S-07 at all; with 3-4 seasons of international games the sample may be permanently too small to pass gate G-01

question: Exact 2026 roster/inactive rules: 53-man, game-day actives 47/48, practice-squad size, elevation limits, IR return designations.
what_we_have: Conflicting secondary sources only; no official text read
what_we_need: The relevant rulebook/operations articles and the CBA roster section
how_to_obtain: Read the official rulebook + operations pages
decision_it_unblocks: Affects how many replacement players a team can hide and how a '4th-string' situation arises at all; also affects the 48th-man roster spot signal

question: Do crew assignments or officiating tendencies have any exploitable content?
what_we_have: No data
what_we_need: Weekly official crew assignments + penalties drawn per crew per game
how_to_obtain: nfl.com officiating page (official-league) + derived from Q-04
decision_it_unblocks: Whether to keep S-12 in the catalogue; current prior is that it is priced in, but it should be tested, not assumed

question: How do we want to treat the season's incentive spots (eliminated teams, seeding, rest-the-starters risk in Week 18)?

how_to_obtain: Owner decision - one afternoon
